typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int,int> pii;
typedef vector<int> vi;

#define rep(i,a,b) for(int i=(a);i<(b);++i)
#define per(i,a,b) for(int i=(b)-1;i>=(a);--i)
#define pb push_back
#define all(x) x.begin(),x.end()
#define sz(x) (int)x.size()
#define lowbit(x) ((x)&-(x))

const int N = 2e5 + 5;
const int INF = ~0U >> 1;

template<class U, class V>
struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    static const int MAXN = 30000, MAXM = 7010010;
    int head[MAXN], inq[MAXN], prev[MAXN], to[MAXM], nxt[MAXM], edge_cnt, src, sink, nodes;
    U cap[MAXM];
    V dist[MAXN], cost[MAXM];

    void init(int _n = MAXN) {
        fill(head, head + (nodes = _n), -1);
        edge_cnt = 0;
    }

    void add_edge(int u, int v, U c, V w) {
        to[edge_cnt] = v;
        nxt[edge_cnt] = head[u];
        cap[edge_cnt] = c;
        cost[edge_cnt] = w;
        head[u] = edge_cnt++;
    }

    void link(int u, int v, U c, V w) {
        add_edge(u, v, c, w);
        add_edge(v, u, 0, -w);
    }

    bool spfa() {
        queue<int> q;
        fill(dist, dist + nodes, INF);
        q.push(src);
        inq[src] = 1;
        dist[src] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int cur = q.front(); q.pop();
            inq[cur] = 0;
            for (int k = head[cur]; ~k; k = nxt[k]) {
                if (cap[k] > 0) {
                    int v = to[k];
                    if (dist[cur] + cost[k] < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[cur] + cost[k];
                        prev[v] = k;
                        if (!inq[v]) {
                            q.push(v);
                            inq[v] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != INF;
    }

    U flow;
    V mincost;

    pair<U, V> run(int _src, int _sink) {
        src = _src;
        sink = _sink;
        flow = 0;
        mincost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            U add = INF;
            int p, k;
            for (p = sink; p != src; p = to[k ^ 1]) {
                k = prev[p];
                add = min(add, cap[k]);
            }
            for (p = sink; p != src; p = to[k ^ 1]) {
                k = prev[p];
                cap[k] -= add;
                cap[k ^ 1] += add;
            }
            mincost += add * dist[sink];
            flow += add;
        }
        return make_pair(flow, mincost);
    }
};

MinCostMaxFlow<int, int> mcmf;
int n, m, k, c, d, a[55], id[55][2500];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);

        }
    }

    rep(i, 1, n + 1) rep(j, 0, mx) mcmf.link(id[i][j], id[i][j + 1], INF, c);
    rep(i, 1, k + 1) mcmf.link(s, id[a[i]][0], 1, 0);
    rep(j, 1, mx + 1) mcmf.link(id[1][j], t, INF, 0);

    int ans = mcmf.run(s, t).second;
    printf("%d\n", ans);

struct MinCostFlow {
    int n;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<int> dist, prevv, preve;
    vector<int> potential;

    MinCostFlow(int _n) : n(_n), g(_n), dist(_n), prevv(_n), preve(_n), potential(_n, 0) {}

    void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        g[from].push_back({to, (int)g[to].size(), cap, cost});
        g[to].push_back({from, (int)g[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost});
    }

    int min_cost_flow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            priority_queue<pii, vector<pii>, greater<pii>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, v] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                if (dist[v] < d) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = g[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to];
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) potential[v] += dist[v];
            int d = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) d = min(d, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            flow += d;
            cost += d * potential[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return cost;
    }
};

int n, m, k, c, d, a[55], id[55][2500];

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d%d%d", &n, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) scanf("%d", &a[i]);

    int mx = 100;
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= mx; ++j)
            id[i][j] = ++cnt;

    int total_nodes = cnt + 5;

    for (int j = 1; j <= mx; ++j)
